# Innovation goal set · [Bet name] · Stage: [discovery / pilot / scale]

## Outcome goal (SMART)
By [date], [segment] will [behavior or outcome] from [baseline] to [target], measured by [source]. Owner: [name].

## Leading indicator
[Metric that moves before the outcome], reviewed [weekly / monthly]. Expected direction: [up / down].

## Guardrails
- [Metric] must not fall below [threshold].
- [Metric] must not rise above [threshold].

## Learning goal for this stage
[Assumption] will be confirmed or refuted by [date], using [experiment or evidence]. Confirmed means [result]. Refuted means [result].

## Gaming check
If the team optimized only the outcome goal, what could go wrong? [answer]. Which guardrail prevents it? [answer].

## Stage logic
Early stage: the learning goal leads. Pilot: learning goal and leading indicator lead. Scale: the outcome goal leads. Guardrails apply at every stage.
